summary: Your 101 Harley Street clinic has a named GMC doctor, Google reviews and press logos, but there is no visible proof of results and details do not match.

findings.problem: No before and after images or patient photos appear, no prices show on the homepage, and there is no WhatsApp. Booking is a separate page.
findings.cost: Aesthetic patients choose on results and cost, and may not click through to find them.
findings.fix: Captioned results, from prices and a short booking form.

findings.problem: One Susie MacLean review appears twice with different Google links, Eva Webb's review shares Susie's link, and every reviewer shows the same placeholder logo.
findings.cost: Repeated reviews and one link for different people weaken the proof you do have.
findings.fix: A clean review wall with each review linked correctly.

findings.problem: Typos include entrpeneur, renown, Silhoutte and Backgound. The header says Rated 4.9 while the badge says 5 Star Rated On Google.
findings.cost: Spelling slips on a Harley Street page cost credibility.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and one consistent rating.

findings.problem: Visit us and Learn More point to anchors #findus and #meetdrduncan, the chemical peels link differs between body and menu, and the doctor appears as Dr Duncan Brennand, Duncan Brennand and Dr. Brennand.
findings.cost: Mismatched links and names look careless.
findings.fix: Working links and one consistent name.

redesign: A short booking form, WhatsApp and from prices on every treatment page.
Captioned before and after results and a clean, consistent review wall.
